title: Endotherm vs Ectotherm, the Defended Setpoint, and Metabolic Disease
abstract: One measured promoter read (gamma) on the R19 setpoint scale separates endotherm (defended setpoint) from ectotherm (ambient-tracking); the gene criterion is a present {UCP1+ADRB3} pair (four pre-registered nulls show gamma is blind to function, and a second GC-normalized methylation-substrate read also fails to mark hibernation); the torpor transition is a bistable switch present-but-silenced in non-hibernators; metabolic disease is one derived loop-gain-drop law; restoration uses the analgesic three-lever method, with a precision compartment-routing layer (regional vs systemic; gamma firewalled out of the routing). Deterministic, proposal-only, CC BY 4.0.
headline_results: gene criterion = present {UCP1+ADRB3} pair, not a gamma value
torpor is a bistable switch (hysteresis width 1.3000)
16/16 stress targets pass; every clinical magnitude [O]
firewall: gamma = promoter switch-threshold structure; never a temperature, metabolic rate, glucose level, HbA1c, dose, or clinical effect.
